role: AI Developer – AI Agents, Automation & Dashboards
fit_line: AI agents, dashboards and integrations on Claude and Gemini, built by one developer who ships the full stack with Claude Code. Fully remote from India.
ai_in_job: "Design, build and deploy AI agents using LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini)" and "turn manual work into AI agents across the group"; "Expert in Claude" is required.

screening_answers.question: How many years have you built AI/LLM applications used in production?
screening_answers.answer: I have 3 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer at a US-based medical-device company, where I built AI agents for internal use alongside web apps and a CRM. Outside work I build LLM applications with Claude and Gemini, including RAG agents and multi-agent systems, all on GitHub.

screening_answers.question: Share a link to an AI agent, automation or dashboard you built.
screening_answers.answer: ai-lead-receptionist: github.com/huss2003/ai-lead-receptionist (Claude, Twilio, Supabase). Also site-to-agent (RAG with evals) and contractor-ai-ops-dashboard, all at github.com/huss2003. Portfolio: hussain-singapuri.vercel.app

screening_answers.question: Which automation tools have you used (n8n, Make, Zapier, custom code)?
screening_answers.answer: Custom code: Python and Node.js workflows with signed webhooks, Twilio SMS, HubSpot events, PostHog and web crawlers. I have not listed n8n, Make or Zapier experience.

screening_answers.question: Which LLM APIs have you integrated (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, other)?
screening_answers.answer: Claude API (multi-agent-research-crew, ai-lead-receptionist) and Gemini API (PageForge, TripSync with structured outputs). I hold the Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F) and use Claude Code daily.

screening_answers.question: What is your expected monthly salary in INR?
screening_answers.answer: To be confirmed by Hussain before submitting.

needs_you: Confirm whether any n8n, Make or Zapier work exists before answering the automation-tools question.
State the expected monthly salary in INR.
Record the optional 2-minute video or note on one agent (ai-lead-receptionist or site-to-agent suggested).
knockout_warnings: Requires a portfolio of 2 AI agents built for real businesses: his are internal agents and open-source projects, so frame them honestly.
n8n, Make or Zapier is required: the CV lists workflow automation in custom code but none of these platforms.
OAuth, WhatsApp Business API and AWS/Azure are not in the CV; do not claim them.
Shortlisted candidates complete a paid test task; probation is 3 months.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Developer role. I have 3 years of professional full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, where I built AI agents for internal use, several apps including a CRM, and security-tested 5+ live Google Play apps.

Your brief matches what I build. ai-lead-receptionist is a Claude agent that qualifies leads over SMS and web chat and books jobs. site-to-agent is a RAG agent with hybrid retrieval, citations and an eval harness. contractor-ai-ops-dashboard is a Next.js and Postgres dashboard with anomaly alerts and number-checked AI summaries. PageForge adds validator and reviewer approval before AI claims go out, the same human-approval idea you want for payments and refunds.

I am a Claude Certified Developer (CCDV-F) and use Claude Code daily. My automations so far are custom code with webhooks and CRM integrations rather than n8n, Make or Zapier, and I would pick up those platforms quickly. I am in India, available immediately, and happy to do the paid test task.

recruiter_note: 3 yrs full stack at a US medical-device co. Built internal AI agents, a CRM, and Claude/Gemini projects (RAG, lead agent, Next.js dashboard). Claude certified. India remote, immediate start. github.com/huss2003
